name: Mageness
storyline: The elements that once held the world in balance have broken loose, and monster armies pour out of every rift. Three mages set out on an endless road through realms of fire, ice, lightning, earth, water, wind, light and darkness: Mex, who lost Ember Valley to the flames and fights with fire and ice side by side; Magi, a glass cannon who wields the void; and Yoka, a fox girl who burns her foes with fox fire. Each boss they defeat bends the land into the next element, and the road only grows more dangerous with every cycle.
summary: Mageness is a roguelite action RPG for mobile in the "survivors-like" (bullet heaven) style. The player controls a mage with one finger while spells cast automatically against ever-growing monster hordes. On each level-up the player picks one of three spell cards, building a new combination every run. The game features 8 elements (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Water, Wind, Light and Dark), 52 spells and 28 fusion spells created by combining two elements. Runs take place on a single endless path where the elements rotate, each map ending with a boss fight, after which the world transforms into the next element. Between runs, players upgrade talents, collect equipment in six rarities, open chests and choose between three playable mages with distinct signature abilities. The game also includes daily quests, events, achievements, leaderboards and a friends system.
